concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-webhooks-grant-api-node]] - Node.js Grant API notifications for updates to previously granted payment instruments and grantor revocation, with side-qualified update kinds and broad payload-category routes
warnings: Keep this source scoped to webhook notifications about previously granted payment instruments; do not import grant or revoke request behavior from unread adjacent references.
Preserve the grantor-versus-recipient qualification for `GrantorUpdatedGrantedPaymentMethod` and `RecipientUpdatedGrantedPaymentMethod`.
Do not reconstruct attribute field names or kind-specific mappings from the concatenated collected rendering; the page routes additional kind-specific attributes to a separate unread guide.
A revocation notification reports that the grantor revoked the instrument; it does not itself grant revocation authority or document the revocation operation.
